snippet.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Celestial Guardians | Coming April 30!
snippet.description: Get ready to have some fun in the Alolan sun—or moon—with Celestial Guardians, the latest expansion for Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket releasing on April 29, 2025, at 11:00 p.m. PDT! First-partner Pokémon Rowlet, Litten, and Popplio make their Pokémon TCG Pocket debuts alongside the mighty Legendary Pokémon Solgaleo and Lunala, and beloved Trainers from Pokémon Sun and Pokémon Moon.
